 SCHOOL HOLIDAYS IN NOVEMBER 2026 
 School Holidays in November 2026: Check Complete Holiday List and Festival Dates
 Students across various states can look forward to school holidays in November 2026 for major festivals such as Kannada Rajyotsava, Dhanteras, Diwali, Govardhan Puja, Bhai Dooj, Children’s Day, Chhath Puja, Veerangana Uda Devi Martyrdom Day, and Guru Nanak Jayanti. Several holidays fall on weekdays, providing extended breaks from regular classes.
 Nidhi Gupta 2 Nov, 2026 Share
 November 2026 brings several important festivals and cultural celebrations across India, including Diwali, Govardhan Puja, Bhai Dooj, Chhath Puja and Guru Nanak Jayanti. Students in different states may get school holidays during these occasions, depending on the state government's holiday calendar and individual school schedules.
 The November 2026 school holiday list includes national observances, religious festivals and regional celebrations. These holidays provide students with opportunities to participate in cultural traditions and spend time with their families. Parents and students can check the important festival dates and state-wise holiday announcements to plan their academic schedules and festive breaks. School holiday schedules may differ across states depending on regional festivals and government announcements. Students in Maharashtra can refer to the Maharashtra school holiday calendar 2026 to check the holidays applicable to schools across the state.

 Important Festivals and Their Significance in November 2026
 Key cultural, national, and religious occasions observed during the month include:
 Kannada Rajyotsava (November 1): Marks the formation of Karnataka state on November 1, 1956, celebrating the state’s culture, heritage, and language.
 Dhanteras (November 6): Marks the commencement of Diwali celebrations and involves the worship of Goddess Lakshmi and Lord Dhanvantari.
 Diwali (November 8): Celebrates the victory of light over darkness and good over evil, marked by the lighting of diyas, prayers, and festivities.
 Govardhan Puja (November 9): Also referred to as Annakut, this day commemorates Lord Krishna lifting Govardhan Hill to shield the people of Vrindavan from torrential rains.
 Bhai Dooj (November 11): Celebrates the bond between brothers and sisters; it is observed as Bhaiya Dooj in northern India and Bhau Beej in Maharashtra.
 Children’s Day (November 14): Celebrated on the birth anniversary of India's first Prime Minister, Jawaharlal Nehru, highlighting child welfare and development.
 Chhath Puja (November 15): Dedicated to the Sun God and Chhathi Maiya, observed with fasting and ritual offerings during sunset and sunrise.
 Veerangana Uda Devi Martyrdom Day (November 16): Honors Uda Devi, a freedom fighter who fought against British rule during the Revolt of 1857.
 Guru Nanak Jayanti (November 24): Also known as Gurpurab, marks the birth anniversary of Guru Nanak Dev, the founder of Sikhism and the first Sikh Guru.
 School Holidays in November 2026 FAQs
 When is Diwali celebrated in November 2026?
 Diwali is scheduled for November 8, 2026, followed by Govardhan Puja on November 9, 2026, and Bhai Dooj on November 11, 2026. Why is Kannada Rajyotsava celebrated on November 1?
 Kannada Rajyotsava marks the foundation day of Karnataka state, which was formed on November 1, 1956. What is the date for Guru Nanak Jayanti in 2026?
 Guru Nanak Jayanti (Gurpurab) falls on November 24, 2026. Do all schools across India follow the same holiday list for November 2026?
 No, school holidays may vary across different states, union territories, and individual school administrations depending on local practices and government notifications. Have questions about your prep?
